ROCKET_MOTOR_SHORTAGE.summary: Independent sources provide mixed evidence. Company announcements confirm the planned expansion and job creation, but third‑party analysis indicates the broader solid‑rocket‑motor supply chain remains a bottleneck, calling into question whether the announced expansion will actually double capacity in the near term. No independent source was found confirming the multi‑year Tomahawk pact.
ROCKET_MOTOR_SHORTAGE.next_check: Independent verification of the Tomahawk pact (e.g., official Navy press release, Reuters, Bloomberg) is required to confirm the claim. Additional third‑party analysis of L3Harris’s production capacity post‑expansion (e.g., CSIS, GAO) would help assess whether the “more than double” projection is realistic.

verified.claim: L3Harris announced a billion‑dollar expansion to boost solid rocket motor production at its Orange County, Virginia site, expected to more than double manufacturing space and create over 350 jobs over the next five years.
